caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular chest or box with two large heart shapes on its front face. The object is rendered in shades of blue and brown, with the majority of the structure being a bluish-gray color and the hearts in a contrasting brownish-beige tone. The chest has a prominent top ledge and a base with a thinner rectangular border beneath the main face. Above each heart, there are rectangular plaques with text; the left plaque reads "MARCRE.DA.27" and the right one reads "MAUERRIN.89". Both plaques have a light brown background with darker text inside. Below the main section of the chest, there are two rectangular panels separated by a vertical line in the front. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a small technical diagram with dimensions written above and below two horizontal lines. The entirety of the drawing is bordered with double lines, in which the outermost frame is a darker beige and the inner frame is a thinner dark line. The background is a light tan color.
title: Pa. German Chest
